title: Why observability matters for small engineering teams
excerpt: A practical introduction to logs, metrics, and traces, and how small teams can use them to make systems easier to understand.
author: Gid Paragon Team

content.text: Observability helps a team answer an important question: what is happening inside our system right now?
Logs provide detailed events, metrics show changes over time, and traces follow a request across services. Together, these signals turn an outage from a guessing exercise into an investigation.
Start with the questions your team asks
You do not need a complex platform on day one. Begin by recording the signals that help answer your most common support and reliability questions.

title: A small JavaScript project with big learning
excerpt: How a focused community exercise can teach the fundamentals of data, rendering, and accessible interaction without a framework.
author: Gid Paragon Team

content.text: Small projects are a great way to practice the complete path from data to interface. A simple reading list can teach useful habits that transfer to larger applications.
The important lesson is not the size of the project. It is learning to keep data, state, and UI updates clear enough that another person can understand and improve them.
